amp.description: Controls training precision: true/fp16 uses checked FP16 AMP, bf16 uses BF16, and false/fp32 uses full precision. Keep true unless hardware support or numerical stability requires a change.

angle.description: Balances OBB rotation accuracy against box and class losses. Keep it near the default; raise it only when validation boxes are well placed but poorly angled.

auto_augment.description: Chooses a classification augmentation policy. Keep randaugment for a strong general baseline; use null to disable it and activate the hsv color-jitter settings instead.

batch.description: Sets images per batch: -1 targets about 60% GPU memory, a value between 0 and 1 sets a memory fraction, and a positive integer fixes the image count. Keep -1 unless reproducing runs.

bgr.description: Sets the chance of reversing RGB and BGR channels. Leave 0 for normal pipelines; enable only when deployment data may genuinely use either channel order.

box.description: Balances box localization against the other loss terms. Keep it near the default; raise it only when validation boxes are imprecise and class predictions are already strong.

cache.description: Controls decoded-image caching. Leave false when memory is limited; use ram for fastest repeated reads or disk when storage is fast and RAM is insufficient.

channels_last.description: Uses NHWC memory layout on CUDA when true; null/false keeps standard NCHW, and CPU or MPS ignores true. Leave null unless a CUDA benchmark shows a speedup.

close_mosaic.description: Turns off mosaic, MixUp, CutMix, and copy-paste for the final N epochs. Keep 10 for a natural-image finish; use 0 to keep them active throughout.

cls.description: Balances class prediction against localization losses. Keep it near the default; raise it when validation boxes are good but classes are often confused.

cls_pw.description: Controls frequency-based class weighting: 0 disables it and 1 applies full weighting. Leave it at 0 unless validation shows minority classes are consistently ignored.

cls_remap.description: Matches pretrained head rows to the new dataset by class name. Keep it enabled for fine-tuning; disable only to use ordinary shape-based checkpoint loading instead.

compile.description: Uses torch.compile with the Inductor backend. Leave it off for quickest startup and widest compatibility; enable it for longer runs where compile cost may repay in throughput.

copy_paste.description: Controls how many eligible objects are pasted in flip mode, and also the apply probability in mixup mode. Leave 0 unless rare-object or occlusion coverage needs help.

copy_paste_mode.description: Chooses the copy-paste source: flip mirrors objects within the same image, while mixup draws objects from another image. This matters only when copy_paste is above 0.

cos_lr.description: Decays learning rate on a cosine curve from lr0 toward lr0 × lrf. Leave it off for the standard schedule; enable it when a smoother late-training decay validates better.

cutmix.description: Sets the chance of replacing a region with a patch from another image. Leave 0 unless occlusion robustness is needed; start low and verify validation quality.

degrees.description: Rotates images randomly from -degrees to +degrees. Leave 0 when orientation matters; otherwise match the largest realistic rotation in deployment.

deterministic.description: Requests deterministic algorithms for more reproducible runs. Keep it enabled for comparisons; disable only when throughput matters more than repeatability.

device.description: Selects training hardware. Leave auto to use the assigned accelerator; choose a specific device only when running locally and controlling placement yourself.

dfl.description: Balances box-distance regression against other losses: DFL for reg_max > 1, otherwise normalized L1. Keep it near the default; tune only when box edges lag on validation.

dgrad.description: Weights errors in depth gradients and surface boundaries. Keep it near the default; raise it for blurry validation edges, watching for noisier depth surfaces.

dlam.description: Sets SILog's variance focus: 1 is fully scale-invariant and 0 becomes log-RMSE. Leave it at 1 unless absolute depth scale matters to the dataset.

dlog.description: Weights SILog, the primary relative-depth loss. Keep it near the default; change it only when validation shows depth accuracy needs rebalancing against edge quality.

dropout.description: Drops this fraction of classification-head activations during training. Leave 0 unless validation overfits; then try a small value before stronger regularization.

epochs.description: Sets the maximum full passes over the training set. Keep 100 as a baseline; increase it if validation is still improving, while patience can stop a plateau early.

erasing.description: Sets the chance of erasing a random region in classification images. Reduce it when small details define the class; raise it cautiously for occlusion robustness.

fliplr.description: Sets the chance of a left-right flip. Keep 0.5 for direction-neutral objects; use 0 when handedness, text, traffic direction, or left/right labels matter.

flipud.description: Sets the chance of an upside-down training image. Leave 0 when orientation matters; raise it only when vertical flips are plausible in deployment.

fraction.description: Limits dataset size. Test images download only when used for validation. Leave 1 for all selected images; use a 0–1 ratio or integer above 1 for a count. A [train, val, test] list controls each split, and only test accepts 0 for none.

freeze.description: Freezes the first N layers, or a list of layer indices/module names, so their weights do not update. Leave null for full fine-tuning; freeze early layers for small datasets.

hsv_h.description: Randomly shifts hue by up to this fraction of the color wheel. Keep it small when color identifies a class; for classification it applies only when auto_augment is null.

hsv_s.description: Randomly changes color saturation by up to this fraction. Reduce it when saturation is meaningful; for classification it applies only when auto_augment is null.

hsv_v.description: Randomly changes image brightness by up to this fraction. Reduce it for fixed-exposure imagery; for classification it applies only when auto_augment is null.

imgsz.description: Sets the target input size: square batches normally, or the long-side size with rect=true. Keep the model default; increase it for small details or decrease it to save memory and time.

iou.description: Sets the IoU threshold for non-maximum suppression during validation. Keep 0.7 for normal evaluation; lower it when duplicate overlapping detections dominate.

kobj.description: Balances keypoint visibility/objectness against the other pose losses. Keep it near the default; raise it when visible and occluded keypoints are poorly distinguished.

lr0.description: Sets the optimizer step size after warmup. Optimizer=auto ignores it; otherwise lower it for unstable loss or raise it if learning barely moves. Adam-family rates are usually about 10× lower than SGD.

lrf.description: Multiplies lr0 to set the learning rate at the final epoch. Leave it alone for standard fine-tuning; lower values make final updates gentler, while 1 keeps a constant rate.

mask_ratio.description: Downsamples training masks by this factor. Keep 4 for most datasets; lower it for finer boundaries at higher memory cost, or raise it to save memory.

max_det.description: Caps detections retained per image during training validation. Keep 300 unless images legitimately contain more objects; raising it increases NMS, memory, and metric work.

mixup.description: Sets the chance of blending two images and their labels. Leave 0 unless validation benefits from stronger regularization; start low because blended scenes can be unrealistic.

model.description: Base model path or ul:// URI

momentum.description: Carries past gradients into each update as SGD momentum or Adam beta1. Optimizer=auto ignores it; otherwise raise it to smooth noisy updates or lower it if optimization overshoots.

mosaic.description: Sets the chance of combining four images into one training sample. Keep it high for varied scenes and small objects; reduce it when synthetic layouts hurt realism.

multi_scale.description: Varies each batch from imgsz × (1-range) to imgsz × (1+range). Leave 0 for stable speed; use a modest value when deployment object scales vary widely.

nbs.description: Normalizes loss, weight decay, and gradient accumulation independently of the actual batch size. Leave 64 unless intentionally retuning optimization scaling.

optimizer.description: Selects the algorithm that updates model weights. Keep the displayed default for most runs; choose another only to reproduce an experiment or tune its learning-rate and momentum settings.

overlap_mask.description: Merges all instances into one training mask, drawing smaller objects over larger overlaps. Keep it enabled for lower memory use; disable only when separate masks are required.

patience.description: Stops after this many epochs without validation improvement. Keep 100 for long runs, lower it to save compute, or use 0 to disable early stopping.

perspective.description: Applies perspective warping to simulate viewpoint changes. Leave 0 unless deployment includes perspective variation; even 0.001 is strong enough for most datasets.

pose.description: Balances keypoint location against box and class losses. Keep it near the default; raise it only when validation keypoints lag behind otherwise good detections.

pretrained.description: Loads the selected model's learned weights instead of random initialization. Keep it enabled for almost all training; disable only for a deliberate from-scratch experiment.

profile.description: Benchmarks ONNX and TensorRT inference for supported training loggers. Leave it off unless those deployment-speed measurements are needed because profiling adds time.

rect.description: Groups similar aspect ratios to reduce padding. Leave it off for normal randomized training; enable it for unusually wide/tall datasets when efficiency matters more than shape mixing.

resume.description: Restores model, optimizer, scheduler, and epoch state from the last checkpoint or a supplied checkpoint path. Leave false for a new run; use it only to continue an interrupted run.

rle.description: Controls the uncertainty-aware RLE keypoint loss on YOLO26/RLE-capable pose heads; other pose heads ignore it. Leave it at the default unless validation supports changing it.

save_period.description: Saves an extra checkpoint every N epochs. Leave -1 unless intermediate recovery points are needed; best.pt and last.pt are still saved.

scale.description: Varies object scale: non-classification tasks use 1±scale or [min, max], while classification crops from 1-scale to full area. Keep the default unless deployment scales differ substantially.

seed.description: Seeds data order, initialization, and other random operations. Leave it fixed when comparing settings; change it only to measure variation across repeated runs.

shear.description: Shears images randomly from -shear to +shear degrees. Leave 0 unless slanted viewpoints are realistic; large values visibly distort object geometry.

single_cls.description: Maps every dataset category to one class. Leave it off when class identity matters; enable it only for class-agnostic object detection.

time.description: Stops training after this many hours and overrides epochs. Leave null unless the run has a fixed time budget; validation still runs at normal epoch boundaries.

translate.description: Shifts images horizontally and vertically by up to this fraction. Keep it modest; larger values improve position tolerance but crop more objects at image edges.

val.description: Runs validation each epoch for metrics, best.pt selection, and early stopping. Keep it enabled; false skips routine validation but still validates at the final or stopping epoch.

warmup_bias_lr.description: Sets the bias learning rate during warmup. Leave it alone unless tuning early optimization; optimizer=auto overrides it to 0, so select an optimizer first.

warmup_epochs.description: Ramps learning rate and momentum into their configured values over the first N epochs. Keep 3 for most runs; use longer warmup only when early loss is unstable.

warmup_momentum.description: Sets momentum at the start of warmup before it rises to momentum. Leave it near the default; lower it only when the first batches produce unstable updates.

weight_decay.description: Penalizes large weights to reduce overfitting. Leave it near the default; increase it when train quality greatly exceeds validation quality, or decrease it if both underfit.

workers.description: Sets data-loader processes per distributed rank. Keep 8 unless loading starves the GPU; raise it gradually, or lower it for limited CPU/RAM and Windows stability.
